title: Constitutional Authority Alignment — the one supreme object authority, and where every other instrument stands under it
authority: AUTHORED REPOSITORY TRUTH, HELD SUBORDINATE. This binding legislates no law, mints no identity, owns no graph and certifies nothing. UCKP-ART-01 already declares that no architectural authority exists outside the root law; what the repository lacked was the BINDING that says which instrument stands WHERE under it. This file is that binding and only that binding. It is upstream of the engines that read it and must never be produced by one.

constitutional_superior.effect: This binding derives its whole content from the root law. It adds no article, no invariant and no stop condition, because an amendment to fit the data is the failure mode UCKP-ART-17 exists to prevent.

constitutional_basis: UCKP-LAW-0001 (engine/uckp/law.py), UCOS-UCOM-001, UCOS-UCAF-001, UCOS-UFC-001 UFC-15, GOV-005 §5.1/§5.3
why_this_exists: Measured over the tree as it stood before this binding existed: 105 version-controlled JSON
instruments carried a top-level `authority` key. 49 disclaimed authority (`NONE — DERIVED
TRUTH`), 48 disclosed execution-only standing (`ENGINEERING-EXECUTION-ONLY`) and one conveyed
an assignment made elsewhere (`Governed Ownership Authority`) — 98 instruments claiming nothing,
under tokens UCOS-UCAF-001 had already classed non-constitutional. Seven CLAIMED authority
outright, each with the words `AUTHORED REPOSITORY TRUTH`, and each asserting that it is
upstream of the engines that read it.
Every one of those seven claims is, on its own terms, correct: each really is the authoring
surface for what it declares. What none of them said is by WHAT authority it declares it.
Seven instruments each standing as the top of its own chain is seven roots, and UCKP-ART-01
admits exactly one. The condition is not a wrong declaration anywhere; it is a MISSING EDGE
everywhere — no instrument named its superior, so no gate could tell an authority derived from
the root law from an authority invented beside it.
The same absence produced two concrete duplications the repository could see but not measure:
the id-ledger and UCKP identity both mint identity with no declared relation between them, and
UCOS-UGA-001 emits a relationship graph while engine/uckp/graph.py declares what a relationship
IS, again with no declared relation. Neither is a rival implementation. Both were UNDECLARED
subordinations, which is indistinguishable from rivalry to anything that has to check.
This binding adds the missing edges and nothing else. No instrument is migrated, replaced,
regenerated or retired; no identity is re-minted; no engine is rewritten. Seven files gain a
`constitutional_superior` block, and the gate that already runs in verify.sh gains the
invariants that keep an eighth from appearing unbound.

supreme_authority.name: Universal Constitutional Knowledge Principle
supreme_authority.object_model: UCKO — the Universal Constitutional Knowledge Object (engine/uckp/ucko.py)
supreme_authority.supremacy_clause: Every constitutional entity shall exist exactly once as a canonical Universal Constitutional Knowledge Object. Every representation, execution environment and persistence mechanism of that entity is a view of it and holds no independent architectural authority. No architectural authority exists outside this principle.
supreme_authority.exactly_one: There is exactly ONE supreme constitutional object authority. A second instrument declaring role SUPREME is a competing root and is void under UCKP-ART-03.
supreme_authority.why_the_home_is_code: UCKP-ART-11 forbids a generated representation from holding truth, and a law whose only home is a document is a law a document edit can silently repeal. The articles are immutable Python values in engine/uckp/law.py; every register, declaration and certificate that states them is generated from those values. This binding restates no clause it does not quote, and quotes only to be checkable.
supreme_authority.self_grounding: The root law is the single object in the universe whose authority derives from itself (engine/uckp/constitution.py::law_object). If two did, UCKP-ART-01 would be false; if none did, every chain would regress forever and nothing would ground.

object_model.name: Universal Constitutional Knowledge Object
object_model.rule: Exactly ONE object model is declared repository-wide. An instrument that declares object classes states which model those classes PROJECT; it never declares a model of its own.
object_model.why: UCOS-UCOM-001 measured the mission's 36 object dimensions against this model and found 34 already answered by a declared facet or a law. The model was never missing. What was missing was any requirement that an instrument declaring seven object classes say which model they belong to — and a class list that cites no model reads exactly like a second model.

$authority_role_comment: The standing an instrument may hold under the root law. Roles are derived from the articles,
never invented here: each names the article that creates the standing it describes. The set is
OPEN by registration (UCKP-ART-17) — an unknown future standing is one appended entry, never an
amendment to engine/uckp/law.py. Exactly one role is supreme, and exactly one instrument may
Every `definition` below is a CHECKED PROJECTION of engine/uckp/alignment.py::AUTHORITY_ROLES,
not a second wording of it. verify_binding compares them verbatim, so a role whose prose drifts
here fails a test rather than quietly becoming a second definition — which is what UCKP-ART-03
forbids and what a register full of near-identical paraphrases actually is.

SUPREME.definition: the root constitutional law; its authority derives from itself and every other chain terminates at it

PROJECTION.definition: a generated or authored view of what the objects already are; it may state repository reality and may never state law

PERSISTENCE.definition: a storage mechanism holding copies of objects and their identities; where a thing is kept is never what a thing is

EXECUTION.definition: a technology that acts on objects; execution never owns knowledge

EVIDENCE.definition: the record of what was done, kept so an act can be reviewed after the fact; evidence supports truth and never constitutes it

OBSERVATION.definition: the record of what was seen at a moment; taken outside the commit boundary, so it may never enter a canonical digest

DERIVED.definition: an instrument that records or measures the standing of others and asserts nothing of its own

ORTHOGONAL.definition: an instrument that governs a distinct, non-overlapping axis of constitutional responsibility — such as recognition and classification of constitutional instruments — and does not compete for supremacy on the axis Article 1 governs; it holds no authority outside its own declared scope

$relation_comment: How a subordinate instrument stands to the authority above it. The three relations are REUSED
verbatim from UCOS-UFC-001 UFC-15, whose executable gate FG-15-NO-PARALLEL-AUTHORITY already
verifies them over platform surfaces (platform/universal_foundation/convergence.py). UCKP-ART-18
requires an existing canonical object to be reused rather than given a rival, and a second
vocabulary for the identical concept is exactly such a rival. No fourth relation is created.

subordination_relations.DELEGATES: The surface still exists and reaches the authority above it rather than answering for itself.
subordination_relations.SUPERSEDED: The surface once held a competing definition and is now gone. A retired definition that still exists is still a second answer.
subordination_relations.PROJECTION: The surface is a derived or authored view of the objects, holding no independent determination.
subordination_relations.ORTHOGONAL: The surface holds independent, non-overlapping authority on a different axis and neither derives from nor answers to the authority above it; the two are declared non-competing rather than ranked.

plane_relation_to_UFC_15.statement: UFC-15 and this binding are one principle measured on two planes, not two authorities.
plane_relation_to_UFC_15.UFC_15_plane: platform.* Python surfaces, verified by import graph and by absence — platform/universal_foundation/convergence.py.
plane_relation_to_UFC_15.CAA_plane: authority-CLAIMING instruments anywhere in the version-controlled boundary, verified by whether they name a constitutional superior — 00-MASTER/UCOS-UGA-001/uga_engine.py.
plane_relation_to_UFC_15.why_UCKP_is_not_a_model_in_foundation_co: Registering the root law as a model inside UCOS-UFC-001's convergence register would make the platform's constitution the frame that admits the root law, inverting the hierarchy UCKP-ART-01 declares. The vocabulary is reused; the containment is not.
plane_relation_to_UFC_15.no_second_gate: Neither gate is duplicated. FG-15 keeps its population and this binding adds none to it.

$instrument_comment: Every instrument that CLAIMS constitutional authority, with the standing it holds under the root
law. An instrument that DISCLAIMS authority is not listed and needs no entry: it asserts nothing,
so there is nothing to derive. The disclaiming tokens are not invented here either — they are the
non-constitutional token classes UCOS-UCAF-001 already legislates.
`owns` and `may_never_own` are the operative halves. Together they are what makes 'subordinate'
a testable statement rather than a courtesy: the instrument keeps everything it actually
authored, and gives up only the claim to be the top of its own chain.

subordinate_instruments.name: Constitutional Authority Alignment
subordinate_instruments.owns: The record of which instrument holds which standing under the root law.
subordinate_instruments.may_never_own: An authority. This binding confers none, ratifies nothing and occupies no tier.
subordinate_instruments.why_it_binds_itself: It carries a top-level `authority` and therefore appears in its own claim scan. An alignment register exempt from the rule it enforces is the first parallel authority anyone would build, so it is measured by CAA-INV-02 and CAA-INV-03 exactly like every instrument it names.

subordinate_instruments.name: Universal Governance Assimilation
subordinate_instruments.owns: The REPOSITORY REALITY PROJECTION — which version-controlled objects exist, who owns each, what produced it, what it depends on, and which evidence class its governance records belong to. Every one of those is a statement about the repository, and the repository is a persistence and projection binding under UCKP-ART-04.
subordinate_instruments.may_never_own: What an OBJECT is; what an IDENTITY is; what a RELATIONSHIP is. Those are UCKP-ART-02, UCKP-ART-05 and UCKP-ART-07, and they are law.
subordinate_instruments.why_this_is_not_a_demotion: UGA measured 5757 objects that had no identity, no owner and no lifecycle, and nothing else in the repository could have. That work is untouched. What changes is one sentence about where its warrant comes from — which is the sentence that lets a gate tell it apart from an eighth authority nobody vetted.

subordinate_instruments.name: Universal Evidence Universe
subordinate_instruments.owns: The five evidence classes, what each may touch, and the retention and input classification of every declared surface.
subordinate_instruments.may_never_own: Canonical identity. UCKP-ART-12 makes evidence a DELTA a state references; it never makes evidence the state.

subordinate_instruments.name: Universal Observation Universe
subordinate_instruments.owns: What an observation IS, the four truths it separates, the observation kinds, and the rule that a canonical artifact references an observation only through its value-independent identity.
subordinate_instruments.may_never_own: A second identity authority. Observations mint from the one ledger, and the rule that they must is UCKP-ART-05.

subordinate_instruments.name: Generated Artifact Registry
subordinate_instruments.owns: Which artifacts are generated, by which producer, from which input closure, under which input classification.
subordinate_instruments.may_never_own: Truth. UCKP-ART-11 is explicit that generated output never owns it; this register is the machine form of that article over the corpus.

subordinate_instruments.name: Exclusion Register
subordinate_instruments.owns: The classification of excluded filesystem state — which bytes the version-control binding carries and which it does not.
subordinate_instruments.may_never_own: Existence. UCKP-ART-09 makes the repository one persistence mechanism among several, so exclusion from it is a statement about storage and never about whether a thing IS.

subordinate_instruments.name: Mutation Governance Boundary
subordinate_instruments.owns: Which mutation classes exist and which authority disposes of each.
subordinate_instruments.may_never_own: Knowledge. UCKP-ART-10 is that execution never owns it — this instrument already says of itself that it 'does not create a new authority and governs nothing itself', and this entry is where that sentence acquires a superior to be true under.

subordinate_instruments.name: UAKOS Closure 008 validation record
subordinate_instruments.owns: The deterministic result of one named validation, recorded so the act can be reviewed after the fact.
subordinate_instruments.may_never_own: The standard it validated against. A record of a measurement is not the law the measurement was taken under.

subordinate_instruments.name: Constitutional Meta Governance Constitution
subordinate_instruments.owns: Recognition and classification of constitutional instruments: what counts as a Constitution, how instruments rank against each other under the Constitutional Precedence Lattice, and the recording of vacancies, gaps and open constitutional questions across the corpus. Self-bounded by its own front matter: 'Supreme over META-CONSTITUTIONAL MATTER ONLY... Confers NO authority over constitutional content.'
subordinate_instruments.may_never_own: What a canonical knowledge object is; identity; the relationship graph model; persistence, execution or projection authority. Those are UCKP-ART-02, UCKP-ART-05, UCKP-ART-07 and UCKP-ART-04, and CMG-000001 Article LXXXI.2 disclaims them in its own text: 'This instrument holds no substantive authority.'
subordinate_instruments.why_orthogonal_not_subordinate: CMG-000001 never claims authority over the canonical-object axis Article 1 governs, and UCKP-LAW-0001 never claims authority over which instruments are recognized as constitutional (that question is never posed inside the root law). The two claims do not overlap, so neither derives from nor is superior to the other — the same relationship CMG-000001 Article XVI.4 already declares between its own T1M tier and Program Authority (T2). See UCKP-CMG-CONSTITUTIONAL-RECONCILIATION-DETERMINATION.md for the full analysis.

$scan_comment: How an unbound authority claim is FOUND. The scan is over version-controlled paths only, so an
untracked working file can never move the measurement and the gate stays a function of the commit.
An instrument is a claim if it carries a top-level string `authority` that matches none of the
declared disclaiming tokens. Adding a token here narrows a constitutional measurement, so every
token names the located instrument that classes it non-constitutional rather than being asserted.

authority_claim_scan.$why_the_whole_tree: The scan is deliberately not narrowed to a directory. A rival authority is most useful to whoever writes it precisely where nobody is looking, so restricting the sweep to 00-BOOK/DATA or 00-MASTER would leave the only interesting hiding places unmeasured. Every tracked JSON is read; an instrument that cannot be parsed is a finding rather than a skip.

disclaiming_token_source.note: UCAF discovers and classes the executable plane's authority tokens. The classes marked constitutional=false are disclaimers there and are disclaimers here; this binding reuses that determination rather than restating it.

disclaiming_prefixes.basis: UCOS-UCAF-001 UCAF-TC-02 — 00-CMG/CMG-000001 ARTICLE XVI.2: the derived-truth tier records and asserts nothing.
UCOS-UCAF-001 UCAF-TC-01 — 00-CEP/CEP-003 ARTICLE I.3: execution authority SHALL NOT govern, ratify or decide constitutional content.

platform/universal_ownership/catalog/ucos-ownership-declarations.json — the catalogue names the authority under which each assignment binds and never infers one. It conveys an assignment made elsewhere; it constitutes none.

authority_claim_scan.rule: An instrument whose `authority` matches no disclaiming prefix MUST appear in subordinate_instruments with a declared role and at least one article of derivation. There is no third outcome: silence is the condition this binding exists to end.

$identity_comment: TASK: resolve the identity authority duplication. The resolution is that there was never a
second authority — there were two PLANES with no declared edge between them, which is what a
second authority looks like from outside.
engine/uckp/identity.py mints the identity of a constitutional OBJECT: a pure, clock-free,
storage-free URN. 00-BOOK/DATA/id-ledger.json mints the identity of a repository OBJECT: an
append-only UCOS-<CATEGORY>-<NNNNNN> serial, frozen at first sight. `engine/uckp/law.py` holds
both — UCOS-ENGINE-000496 names the FILE, urn:ucos:ucko:ucos:UCKP-LAW-0001 names the LAW. They
were never competing for one subject; nothing said so.
NOTHING IS RE-MINTED. The derivation below carries every existing identifier through verbatim as
the URN's local name, so the ledger is projected into the object model without a single byte of
it changing. That is the whole of the resolution: one authority, two planes, one total and pure
function from the lower to the higher.

identity_authority_resolution.one_authority: UCKP-ART-05 — Universal Identity. Every other identity mechanism in the repository is a persistence or projection binding of it.

planes.properties: pure, total, clock-free, storage-free, repository-free; minting again cannot produce a different answer

planes.identifies: the version-controlled thing that holds, produces or observes an object
planes.properties: append-only; first_seen frozen at mint; never reissued; never renumbered
planes.role: PERSISTENCE — the storage binding of UCKP-ART-05, and the ONE such binding in this repository

derivation.$two_readers_one_truth: The prefix, namespace and id shape are declared HERE and read by both planes: engine/uckp/alignment.py implements the derivation from its own constants, and the stdlib-only enforcing engine composes the URN from these fields. verify_binding resolves this block against those constants, so the two readers cannot drift into two derivations without a test failing.
derivation.properties: TOTAL over every id the ledger holds, PURE, and INJECTIVE — the identifier is carried through verbatim as the local name, so two distinct ledger ids can never derive one URN and no id is rewritten to make the mapping work.
derivation.why_verbatim: Any derivation that reshaped the identifier would be a re-mint wearing a projection's clothes, and UCKP-ART-05 says an identity once minted never changes.

identity_authority_resolution.second_authority_test: A second identity authority would be a second APPEND-ONLY MINT — a file other than the ledger that issues repository identifiers. A mint is recognised by the counter it advances, so the marker below is what CAA-INV-04 looks for; finding it anywhere but the one ledger is a second sequence, whatever the file calls itself.
identity_authority_resolution.$mint_marker_rationale: category_seq is the shared counter every map in the ledger draws from. A second file holding one is issuing identifiers on its own count, which is the only thing 'a second identity authority' can concretely mean. Measured at authoring time: exactly one file holds it.
identity_authority_resolution.ids_preserved: ALL. This binding renames nothing, renumbers nothing, retires nothing and reissues nothing.

$graph_comment: TASK: resolve relationship graph ownership. Same shape as identity, same resolution.
UCKP-ART-07 legislates what a relationship IS — every object a node, every dependency an edge,
and every relationship EXECUTABLE, because a relationship that cannot be resolved is not one.
engine/uckp/graph.py is the one home of that model. UCOS-UGA-001 emits 32902 edges over
repository objects in six kinds. Those are not a rival model; they are a POPULATION measured
in one. The edge that was missing is the one that says each UGA kind is an instance of a UCKP

model_owner.owns: What a relationship is, what an edge is, what makes an edge resolvable, and the requirement that the authority relation stay acyclic (UCKP-INV-04, UCKP-INV-05, UCKP-INV-06).

projections.may_never: declare a relationship KIND that names no class in the model above it

projections.measures: program-to-program dependency rollup, aggregated from each artifact's declared `dependencies` field in 00-BOOK/DATA/artifacts.json — a different grain of the same model, never a rival of it
projections.may_never: declare a relationship KIND that names no class in the model above it, or claim authority over the object-level question the model already answers
projections.$disclaim: Already self-disclaiming: its own `authority` field reads "NONE (derived truth)", matching authority_claim_scan's `NONE` disclaiming prefix (basis: CMG-000001 Article XVI.2). This entry records recognition; it confers nothing the field does not already say.

projections.measures: module-to-module dependency graph derived from actual source-code import statements (AST analysis over tracked .py files) — a different grain and a different source (actual imports, not declared metadata) from the model above it, never a rival of it
projections.may_never: declare a relationship KIND that names no class in the model above it, or claim authority over the object-level question the model already answers
projections.$disclaim: Already self-disclaiming: its own `authority` field reads "ENGINEERING-EXECUTION-ONLY", matching authority_claim_scan's `ENGINEERING-EXECUTION-ONLY` disclaiming prefix (basis: CEP-003 Article I.3). Output is written under `.runtime/`, which `.gitignore` excludes — never committed as canonical state. This entry records recognition; it confers nothing the field and the ignore rule do not already say.

$kind_binding_comment: Every relationship kind the projection emits, bound to the class and relation term the model
actually holds. `uckp_class` is a member of RELATIONSHIP_CLASS_VOCABULARY and `uckp_relation`
a member of RELATION_TYPE_VOCABULARY, both in engine/uckp/vocabulary.py; `direction` records
whether the projection emits the model's edge or its inverse, because a kind read backwards
is still that kind and pretending otherwise would invent a term to avoid saying so.
A kind absent from this map is an unmodelled relationship and fails CAA-INV-05. The map is
DATA, so a seventh kind is one appended entry (UCKP-ART-17) and never an engine change; the
terms it may use are held honest by engine.uckp.alignment.verify_binding, which resolves every
class, relation and article against the model itself.

model_term_sources.note: These lists are NOT copied here. The enforcing engine is stdlib-only by constitutional design and checks kinds against this map; verify_binding checks this map against the vocabularies, so there is one truth and a test between the planes rather than two lists that can drift.

owned_by.meaning: the accountable owner — the ownership facet, read from the owned object toward its owner

produced_by.meaning: the producer whose execution brought the object into being

produces.meaning: the same provenance edge forward, so lineage is traversable in both directions

depends_on.meaning: what must exist for the object to exist — the class derive_edges gives every dependency

validated_by.meaning: the contract that decides whether the object is admissible

evidenced_by.meaning: the evidence class the object's governance records belong to

relationship_graph_resolution.second_model_test: A second relationship model would be a second declaration of what a relationship IS. CAA-INV-05 measures that exactly one instrument declares the model and that every emitted kind resolves into it.

$dependency_evidence_comment: TASK (Phase 0.7): record the ~20 static per-programme dependency-graph documents as what
they are — historical evidence of a closed programme's own measurement at its own closure —
so they are discoverable and unambiguous rather than silently scattered. None of them is a

dependency_evidence_index.declaration: No historical snapshot listed here may serve as a dependency authority. Each is EVIDENCE (UCKP-ART-16) of a closed programme's measurement at its own point in time, never a live or competing truth about current repository state.
dependency_evidence_index.verified_frozen: Sampled by git history at Phase 0.7 authoring time: 00-MASTER/UAKOS-PHASE-004's copy last touched 2026-08-01, 00-MASTER/UCOS-USIS-WAVE1's last touched 2026-07-24 — neither regenerated since, no live producer exists for either.

entries.programme_state: active programme, but this specific file confirmed NOT part of RIB's own live-regenerated surface set (unlike rib.json, 01-REPOSITORY-INVENTORY.md, etc.) — frozen despite its location
evidence directory by its own path — already self-classifying

$certification_comment: TASK: resolve certification authority. Same shape as identity and the relationship graph —
recognition of a plural but non-competing landscape, never a new authority.
DETERMINATION.md), bidirectionally searched for cross-reference, and found to reference each other
in exactly one real, code-level case: platform/certification imports engine.certification by
reference. Every other surface answers a genuinely different question (repository-integration
disposition, meta-constitutional readiness, fixed-point regeneration, validated-subject
certification, knowledge-object completeness, digital-twin corpus integrity...) and holds its own
undisputed authority over that question. None claims another's. This is not fragmentation; it is
what UCKP-ART-01 already permits — architectural authority is one thing (the object model, which
none of these surfaces touches), and domain-bounded engineering determination is another. Nothing
here is bound under role SUPREME, PROJECTION-of-the-model, or any existing AUTHORITY_ROLES member:
those roles govern standing under the canonical-object model specifically (UCKP-ART-01/04/07), and
certification authority is a materially different axis this binding records without conflating.

model.declares: Certification authority in UCOS is plural by design. A certification surface answers one bounded question; holding undisputed authority over that one question is not competition with any other surface holding undisputed authority over a different one.

principles: Certification authority is bounded by certification purpose.
A certification authority owns its lifecycle, its verdict semantics, and its evidence interpretation.

Evidence integrity rules remain globally governed (see evidence_observation_separation and 00-BOOK/DATA/evidence-universe.json's CERTIFICATION_EVIDENCE_CLASS rule — DEBUG/IMPROVEMENT evidence may never influence any certification, anywhere).
Cross-certification relationships require explicit declaration; an undeclared relationship is not assumed to exist.

certification_authority_resolution.second_authority_test: A second certification authority over the SAME bounded question would be a rival. None was found: every pair of surfaces compared either answers a different question, or (EC-2 only) is an explicit, code-confirmed read-only projection of the one that answers it. Full comparison in PHASE-CERTIFICATION-GOVERNANCE-RELATIONSHIP-DETERMINATION.md and CERTIFICATION-OWNERSHIP-RECONCILIATION-FINDING.md.

$truth_comment: TASK: establish evidence vs observation separation. UCOS-OBSERVATION-UNIVERSE-001 already
separated the four truths and UCOS-EVIDENCE-UNIVERSE-001 already closed the evidence classes at
five. Neither said which ARTICLE made the separation binding, so the separation held by the good
sense of two registers rather than by law. These are the articles.

identity_truth.definition: What a thing IS. A pure function of the commit.
identity_truth.home: 00-BOOK/DATA/id-ledger.json and the object registries derived from it

observation_truth.definition: What was SEEN at a moment — working-tree dirtiness, what an actuator wrote, an environment reading.
observation_truth.why: UCKP-ART-13 requires identical inputs to produce identical bytes. A reading taken outside the commit boundary is not an input the commit contains, so admitting one into a canonical digest destroys the fixed point by construction — which is exactly how one stale digest became a permanently non-convergent Phase 8.

evidence_truth.definition: The record kept so an act can be reviewed after the fact.

decision_truth.definition: What was decided, replayable from itself.

separation_rules.rule: An observation is not evidence, and evidence is not an observation.
separation_rules.meaning: An observation is a READING with a value-independent identity. Evidence is a SURFACE with a class, an owner, a producer and a retention policy. The reading LANDS on the surface; it never becomes it.

separation_rules.rule: Every observation kind binds to exactly one of the five evidence classes, and creates no sixth.
separation_rules.meaning: The reading has somewhere to live the moment it is declared, so removing a value from canonical identity relocates evidence rather than deleting it.

separation_rules.rule: Neither register may hold the other's subject. The evidence register declares no observation kind; the observation register declares no sixth evidence class.
separation_rules.meaning: Two registers that can each define the other's terms are one register with two names, and the separation is decorative.

id_preservation.rule: Every identifier that existed before this binding exists after it, unchanged.
scope: every artifact_id in every bound instrument
id_preservation.method: This binding is additive only. It appends a `constitutional_superior` block to seven instruments, appends CAA invariants to a register that already exists, and adds no map, no counter and no sequence.
id_preservation.measured_by: CAA-INV-04, which recomputes the derivation over every ledger id and fails on any collision or any id it cannot carry through verbatim.

determinism.rule: No measurement this binding drives reads a wall clock, the working tree or the network.
determinism.inputs: version-controlled paths (git ls-files), this binding, and the instruments it names
determinism.consequence: A second run over an unchanged commit rewrites no byte, so Phase-8 fixed point and Phase-9 pristine clone stay checkable by plain comparison.
determinism.measured_by: the existing Phase-8 fixed-point run; this binding adds no dimension to it

$invariant_comment: The governance invariants that prevent a duplicate authority from appearing. They are measured by
00-MASTER/UCOS-UGA-001/uga_engine.py alongside UGA-INV-01..10 and OBS-INV-01..10, and are

invariants.name: EXACTLY_ONE_SUPREME_CONSTITUTIONAL_AUTHORITY
invariants.statement: Exactly one instrument holds role SUPREME, it is UCKP-LAW-0001, and its declared home exists.

invariants.name: EVERY_AUTHORITY_CLAIM_NAMES_ITS_CONSTITUTIONAL_SUPERIOR
invariants.statement: Every tracked instrument whose declared authority matches no disclaiming token is bound here with a role and at least one article of derivation.

invariants.name: NO_SUBORDINATE_INSTRUMENT_CLAIMS_INDEPENDENT_AUTHORITY
invariants.statement: Every bound instrument carries a constitutional_superior block naming UCKP-LAW-0001, whose declared role and articles match this binding and resolve in the root law.

invariants.name: EXACTLY_ONE_IDENTITY_AUTHORITY
invariants.statement: One append-only mint holds every repository identity, every declared map resolves in it, and the derivation into the object model is total and injective over every id it holds.

invariants.name: EXACTLY_ONE_RELATIONSHIP_GRAPH_MODEL_OWNER
invariants.statement: One instrument declares what a relationship is, and every relationship kind any projection emits binds to a class and an article of that model.

invariants.name: EVIDENCE_AND_OBSERVATION_REMAIN_SEPARATE_TRUTHS
invariants.statement: The four truths each name a governing article, every observation kind binds to one of the five evidence classes, no sixth class is created, and neither register declares the other's subject.

invariants.name: NO_INSTRUMENT_DECLARES_A_RIVAL_OBJECT_MODEL
invariants.statement: One object model is declared repository-wide. Every bound instrument that declares object classes names UCKO as the model they project, and every declared authority role resolves to an article of the root law.

invariants.name: ORTHOGONAL_ROLE_IS_SCOPE_BOUNDED_AND_NON_SUPREME
invariants.statement: Every instrument bound under role ORTHOGONAL declares an explicit, non-unrestricted scope naming the axis its authority is bounded to, and role ORTHOGONAL never resolves as a supreme role; Article 1 continues to admit exactly one.

extension_rule.principle: Every future capability becomes an EXTENSION of the Universal Constitutional Object Model, never a competing authority beside it.
how_to_extend: A new family of constitutional objects is a new provider module under engine/uckp/ exposing ucko_objects(). The registry discovers it; engine/uckp/universe.py is never edited (UCKP-ART-08).
A new vocabulary member, relationship class, adapter or authority role is one appended entry in DATA. engine/uckp/law.py is never amended to fit the data (UCKP-ART-17).
A new repository capability declares its role and its articles in subordinate_instruments here, and gains a constitutional_superior block. It does not declare a root.
Before creating anything, its canonical object is located and reused, extended or referenced (UCKP-ART-18).
extension_rule.what_this_forbids: A second registry, engine, lifecycle, identity authority, relationship graph or evolution system standing beside the ones that exist. Not because expansion is untidy, but because UCKP-ART-03 makes a second definition of an existing primitive void, and CAA-INV-01..07 make that voidness measurable.

non_goals: Creating an authority. This binding confers none, ratifies nothing and occupies no tier.
Migrating, replacing or retiring any instrument. Every one keeps everything it authored.
Re-minting, renumbering or reissuing any identity.
Adding an article, invariant or stop condition to engine/uckp/law.py. Extension is by registration (UCKP-ART-17).
Adding a verification stage, pipeline or scheduler. The invariants land in the gate verify.sh already runs.
Deciding a conflict between two located instruments. Where one is found, it is measured and reported, never disposed of here.
